description:
About Megaport
We’re not your typical tech company - and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Our Team Culture
We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here - collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. About SoSafe
SoSafe is a leading human risk management platform designed to transform the "human factor" from a security vulnerability into a proactive layer of defense. We focus on driving measurable behavior change and quantifiable risk reduction for our global customers.

The role.
You'll run product marketing for SoSafe's AI-native product: our next generation of human risk management. It is a Tier 1 Launch, due in early 2027, and the year's plan depends on it landing. It advances scheduled awareness campaigns with autonomous security programmes and deeper telemetry. It reads threat intelligence, each person's role and access, and how they behave, then adapts simulations and learning through LLM-driven interventions. You own the market voice for this product from first evidence to day-90 revenue review, and you deliver integrated launches judged by commercial impact.

Working location: This role will initially be fully remote from Barcelona. Once our Barcelona hub opens in the near future, the role will transition to a hybrid working model

Who you are

- You're a product marketer who measures your work in pipeline and revenue, not assets shipped. You've launched B2B SaaS products and seen them through to commercial results. Ideally one of them was an AI-native product, and ideally in security or another regulated, technical market.

- AI-native in how you work. You already use AI tools to research, synthesise, test messaging and produce enablement. You can show us how this changed your speed or quality, and you'll help the team work this way too.

- Buyer-first. You translate technical capability into what a CISO, a CIO or a procurement lead cares about, and you're comfortable explaining AI autonomy, data protection and auditability to sceptical audiences.

- Evidence-led. You run discovery and win/loss yourself, and you'd rather launch on one strong customer proof point than ten unproven claims.
Comfortable in ambiguity. The product, the market and the name will all evolve. You plan in short cycles, act on new evidence, and keep moving without waiting for perfect answers.

- A strong partner to product and sales. Product managers want you in discovery; sales leaders trust your talk tracks. You influence without authority.
International by default. You've taken products to more than one market, and you know when to localise the message, not just translate it. German or French is a plus.

About the launch
In 2027 we move from launches that produce assets to launches that move revenue: every Tier 1 and 2 launch is built on a validated, evidenced message and ends with a day-90 commercial review.
Security teams set the guardrails and get analytics that show where risk sits and what reduced it. It matters because awareness training alone is becoming a commodity: this is how SoSafe moves beyond it, and how we grow with existing customers as well as win new ones.
You are the market voice inside the Tier 1 Launch product team and own the launch end to end. Your rule is proof before promises: we launch on what customers have shown us, not on what we hope.

Core accountabilities

- Value propositions, messaging & competitive narrative
Turn product capabilities into clear, customer-focused value propositions that set us apart in an increasingly crowded AI security market.

- Lead positioning, messaging and the re-name. Tell the story as outcomes for the buying committee (CISO, CIO, HR/L&D, procurement): autonomous, but accountable, auditable and European by design.

- Own the competitive narrative, battlecards and win/loss insight, and keep them current as competitors and the market move.
Tier 1 Launch with proof

- Run the Tier 1 Launch against our tiered launch process: leadership sign-off, beta cohort, pricing gate, GTM intake brief (T-14), Sales trained before GA.
Build the evidence GA depends on: aha-moment definition, positioning hypothesis, design-partner and beta debriefs, outcome data and approved customer quotes.

- Plan t
